title: Locked-out user
why: Checks that the lockout rule is enforced, so a user at the failure limit with a future LockoutEnd is refused even with the correct password.

steps.does: Attempt to sign in as marcus.oyelaran@example.com with the correct password, on 2026-10-23, before LockoutEnd.

expect: Sign-in is rejected as locked out and no session or token is issued. AccessFailedCount stays 5 and LockoutEnd is unchanged. The correct password does not bypass the lockout. After 2026-10-24T09:00:00Z a correct sign-in succeeds and resets the failure count to 0.
